rows.en: ＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０２７Oh, it's just you...￥Don't scare me like that!
＊Narusawa＊＠１１２＿００２Ah, can I ask you something...＝＠１１２＿００３Have you seen Rei? Mechanic with￥messy hair, brown coveralls and￥a nasty look in his eye?
＊Narusawa＊＠１１２＿００５I knew you were here, Rei!!￥Quit skipping work to￥goof off!!
＊Rei＊＠１１２＿００６It's all boring junk anyway, so￥let somebody else do it!!
＊Narusawa＊＠１１２＿００７What are you talking about?!￥Work is meant to be shared!＝＠１１２＿００８You can't be the only one￥slacking off!＝＠１１２＿００９Hey! Rei!!￥Don't you run!!
＊Narusawa＊＠１１２＿０１１I see. If you spot him,￥let me know.＝＠１１２＿０１２Sorry for interrupting your￥training.
＊Rei＊＠１１２＿０１４Whew!￥Thanks, thanks a bunch!￥You saved my hide!
＊Rei＊＠１１２＿０１７Hey now, are you blushing?￥You're a weird one!＝＠１１２＿０１８I never even asked you to hide￥me, so I figured I was a goner￥for sure.
＊Rei＊＠１１２＿０２１Well, I guess I'm partly to￥blame for skipping work...
＊Rei＊＠１１２＿０２４Man, Narusawa never lets up!￥Shaking him was tough!
＊Rei＊＠１１２＿０２５It's all tedious grunt work that￥takes forever. Too much hassle,￥so I bailed.
＊Rei＊＠１１２＿０２６Huh?￥Well, y'see...＝＠１１２＿０２７I got stuck with this lousy job.￥Takes forever, and it's just￥mindless grunt work...
＊Rei＊＠１１２＿０２８It was such a pain that I tried￥to ditch it, and he caught me.
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿００１He looked ready to lecture me￥all day long. I'd be dead meat￥if he caught me.
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿００２But man, that jerk Narusawa￥said some nasty stuff, huh!＝＠１１３＿００３"Messy hair" and a "nasty look"!
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿００４My hair's like this on purpose!￥I was born with these eyes!!￥Leave me alone!!＝＠１１３＿００５He's always got it in for￥me... Seriously, that guy!
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿００７Every time we meet, I get a￥lecture. Now I run the second￥I see his face.
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿００８But c'mon, lecturing somebody￥every single time? Don't you￥think that's a bit much?
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿００９You ever heard one of his￥lectures? They go on forever!＝＠１１３＿０１０Then again, a "candidate" like￥you might not get it!

＊Rei＊＠１１３＿０１２But you gotta understand why I￥wanna slack off.＝＠１１３＿０１３I'm the guy who maintains the￥main computer, y'know?＝＠１１３＿０１４And they grab a guy like that￥for fixing lights, adjusting￥shower pressure...
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿０１７A real pro's gotta take￥pride in his work!!
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿０１８I just wanna do the job I'm￥supposed to do, y'know?＝＠１１３＿０１９Wanting to do your own job is￥only natural, right?
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿０２０Right?＝＠１１３＿０２１If it's not my job, better to￥skip it than drag my feet￥through it.
＊Rei＊＠１１３＿０２２Ugh, you sound just like￥Narusawa!＝＠１１３＿０２３Real noble of you, but it's￥not for me...＝＠１１３＿０２４Well, later. Thanks for￥hiding me...

＊Rei＊＠１１３＿０２５I don't bother sharing views￥like this with people who won't￥get 'em!＝＠１１３＿０２６Easier to just avoid 'em!＝＠１１３＿０２７I think you and me are gonna￥get along fine, so I bet we'll￥run into each other again!＝＠１１３＿０２８Later!!
